caption: The drawing on a light beige background features two main objects. On the left side, there is a detailed depiction of a metal branding iron with a long handle extending to the right and ending in a curled tip. The branding surface forms the outline of a trophy cup or goblet, with a rectangular base, a stem, a rounded bowl, and two handles, all in brown and steel grey shades. The branding iron is rendered with a three-dimensional appearance, showing highlights and shading to indicate its metallic material. To the right of the branding iron, there is a simple line drawing in brown of the same trophy cup or goblet shape seen in the branding iron, showing its intended imprint, composed of an oval bowl, a handle on the right, a short stem, and a flat base. The drawing is minimalist, with open space and no background elements except for the objects described.
title: Branding Iron
